prompt:
Image 1 is a flat lay of a Track & Field kit, photographed from the front.

Photograph THAT SAME KIT from the BACK — the same garments, turned over:
- the shirt, laid flat and face DOWN, so its back is what you see
- the shorts below it, also turned so their back is what you see
EXACTLY ONE of each. No socks, no shoes, no ball, nothing else in the frame.

Everything carries over from image 1 unchanged: the same colours, the same fabric, the
same cut, the same collar, and above all the SAME PANELS AND
TRIM — a stripe, a panel or a piping that exists on the front continues around to the
back exactly as the garment's construction would carry it. Nothing is added that image 1
does not have, and nothing that image 1 has quietly disappears.

SLEEVES: this is the same garment as image 1, so it has exactly the same sleeves. If the
shirt in image 1 has short sleeves, this one has short sleeves and is NOT a sleeveless
vest or a tank top. If image 1 is sleeveless, this one is sleeveless. Look at image 1 and
copy what is there.

THE KIT — these are settled decisions, not suggestions. Do not substitute anything.
- shirt: A GOLD sleeveless track SINGLET exactly as photo2.png shows it: a plain ROUND SCOOP NECK with no collar and no placket, cut away at the armholes, and the body of it PLAIN GOLD all over — there is NO contrasting side panel, NO stripe and NO trim of any other colour anywhere on it, whatever the sport default says. The club badge sits CENTRED HIGH ON THE CHEST, a hand's width below the neckline: the redstone-flyers mark exactly as the crest artwork draws it — a gold winged foot inside a white field ringed by a solid dark band — about a palm across, soft-edged and moving with the fabric. It is the ONLY mark on the singlet. NO maker's logo, NO swoosh, NO sponsor, NO club name, NO player name, no lettering of any kind. The BACK of the singlet is not visible in any photograph; the DECISION is that it stays PLAIN GOLD: no number, no name, no badge and no lettering across the shoulders or anywhere else on it. This kit carries its race number on the SHORTS, and a second number across the back would print a mark this singlet does not have.
- shorts: GOLD MID-THIGH COMPRESSION SHORTS exactly as photo2.png shows them: close-fitting, plain gold all over, ending about halfway down the thigh, with a plain waistband and no stripe, no piping and no side panel. On HER LEFT THIGH, on the outside of the leg — the side that appears on the RIGHT of the frame when she faces the camera — a small WHITE RECTANGULAR RACE-NUMBER PATCH carrying the number 8 in plain black. One patch only, on her left leg only, and the number 8 appears nowhere else on the kit. NO maker's logo and no lettering on the shorts.
- socks: NO SOCKS, or none that can be seen: photo2.png and photo3.png both show BARE ANKLES above the shoe. The DECISION is that she races in no visible sock — bare skin from the hem of the compression shorts to the top of the shoe in every frame. Do not add a gold sock, and do not add a white one.
- footwear: PLAIN BLACK track shoes exactly as photo2.png and photo3.png show them after the maker's mark was taken off: an all-black low-cut shoe with black laces and a black sole, completely PLAIN and UNBRANDED — no swoosh, no stripes, no maker's mark, no logo and no lettering of any kind, on either shoe or anywhere on the sole. The same pair in every frame. This overrides the sport default of white spikes: the photographs show black, and the photographs decide what the kit looks like.
- equipment: NO IMPLEMENT IS PART OF THIS KIT. Track and field carries no ball, stick, racket or apparatus, and none appears in any photograph. What she does carry is ordinary kit-bag clutter on the way to and from the track: in photo2.png a plain dark DUFFEL BAG slung on one shoulder, and in photo3.png bags and a plain unbranded water bottle on the ground beside her — all of it unbranded, and none of it a piece of sports equipment. The DECISION for the poses is that she carries NOTHING in her hands: no baton, no bag, no bottle, no block. Starting blocks may stand on the track where a pose calls for them, but nothing is held.
- Where an item above is described from the athlete's own photographs, any manufacturer's
  logo it genuinely carries stays on it — that is their real clothing.
- The club crest sits CENTRED HIGH ON THE CHEST of the singlet, a hand's width below the neckline, about a palm across. That position is a settled decision read off photo2.png, not a convention to be corrected: do not move it to the left chest, do not enlarge it and do not add a second mark. That position is settled and is the same in every frame.

THE BACK OF THE SHIRT carries the squad number 8, plus whatever else the
kit description above explicitly gives it — and nothing more. Add no mark the description
does not name.
NEVER any lettering: no club name, no player name, no sponsor, no word of any kind.
Nothing sits inside, on top of or overlapping the numerals — a badge, if the description
calls for one, is small, clear of the number, and the right way round.

Hard requirements:
- Everything is BRAND NEW and immaculate: no dirt, no scuffs, no wear, no sweat marks.
- Flat lay from directly overhead. No mannequin, no person, no body, no hanger, no rail.
- The same plain light grey surface and the same even lighting as image 1.
- No text of any kind beyond the number, no labels, no neck tag, no watermark.
- Sharp throughout, photographic, print quality. Square image.
